summary: All 8 acceptance-matrix criteria exercised. Backend suite (18 tests across 8 files) passes; 9 browser checks (8 criteria + 1 public-preview smoke) pass. No bugs found.

checks.criterion: Login + RBAC: valid super_admin login reaches Dashboard; invalid password rejected; cs sees fewer nav items.
checks.name: test_tscheck_login_rbac.py
checks.evidence: POST /auth/login superadmin -> 200 role=super_admin; PUT /settings as finance -> 403; POST /auth/login wrong password -> 401.

checks.criterion: Login + RBAC: valid super_admin login reaches Dashboard; invalid password rejected; cs sees fewer nav items.
checks.name: login-rbac-dashboard
checks.evidence: super_admin login -> dashboard stats visible + Settings nav link present; wrong password -> 'Email atau password salah' shown; cs login -> dashboard visible but Settings nav link count=0.

checks.criterion: Dashboard renders stats and charts without errors using seeded data.
checks.name: dashboard-stats-charts
checks.evidence: Total Pelanggan, Pendapatan Bulanan chart heading, Status Pelanggan chart heading all visible after login; no console errors beyond an expected transient 401 before auth cookie settles.

checks.criterion: Pelanggan list + search/filter/pagination and detail sheet.
checks.name: customers-list-search-detail
checks.evidence: Data Pelanggan heading + GMP-000031 row visible; search 'GMP-000031' filters to Rizky Saputra; clicking row opens detail sheet showing MikroTik section.

checks.criterion: Create a new Pelanggan, optionally with 'Create PPPoE User on MikroTik'.
checks.name: customers-create-new-pelanggan
checks.evidence: Empty submit blocked (dialog stays open). Full form incl. router+PPPoE creds submitted -> POST /api/customers 200 {customer_code: GMP-000042, name: tscheck-newcust-...}. Also covered by backend test_tscheck_customer_crud_pppoe.py.

checks.criterion: Create a new Pelanggan, optionally with 'Create PPPoE User on MikroTik'.
checks.name: test_tscheck_customer_crud_pppoe.py
checks.evidence: POST /customers with create_pppoe=true -> 200, integration_status SUCCESS; POST with missing required field -> 422.

checks.criterion: Tagihan: generate monthly invoices (idempotent) and pay an invoice via pay dialog.
checks.name: invoices-generate-and-pay
checks.evidence: POST /invoices/generate run 1 -> {created:3, skipped:36}; run 2 same period -> {created:0, skipped:39} confirming idempotency. Paid BELUM BAYAR row via dialog -> toast 'Invoice LUNAS' and row status becomes LUNAS.

checks.criterion: Tagihan: generate monthly invoices (idempotent) and pay an invoice via pay dialog.
checks.name: test_tscheck_invoices_generate_pay.py
checks.evidence: POST /invoices/generate twice for same period -> second run created=0 (idempotent); pay endpoint marks invoice paid.

checks.criterion: Pembayaran: confirm a pending payment; flows to invoice paid and no duplicate side-effects on re-confirm.
checks.name: payments-confirm-pending
checks.evidence: Created pending payment (unchecked 'Konfirmasi langsung'); found row on /payments; clicked Konfirmasi -> toast 'Pembayaran dikonfirmasi - invoice LUNAS', status badge TERKONFIRMASI.

checks.criterion: Network modules: MikroTik Routers TEST CONNECTION + SYNC, Monitoring PPPoE, GenieACS device list and actions.
checks.name: network-routers-pppoe-acs
checks.evidence: Test Connection dialog shows stepwise 'Terhubung ke MikroTik API / Autentikasi berhasil / Router Identity terdeteksi / Versi RouterOS terdeteksi' -> Connected. Sync dialog shows 11 synced/0 created/1 updated/2 skipped/0 failed. PPPoE monitoring table populated with live sessions (GET /mikrotik/pppoe returned rows). GenieACS wifi-change dialog opened for a device with SSID/password fields.

checks.criterion: Network modules: MikroTik Routers TEST CONNECTION + SYNC, Monitoring PPPoE, GenieACS device list and actions.
checks.name: test_tscheck_mikrotik_routers.py
checks.evidence: POST /mikrotik/routers/{id}/test -> 200 simulator success; POST /mikrotik/routers/{id}/sync -> 200 with counts.

checks.criterion: Network modules: MikroTik Routers TEST CONNECTION + SYNC, Monitoring PPPoE, GenieACS device list and actions.
checks.name: test_tscheck_mikrotik_actions.py
checks.evidence: PPPoE enable/disable/disconnect actions against simulator -> 200 ActionResult SUCCESS, logged in action log.

checks.criterion: Network modules: MikroTik Routers TEST CONNECTION + SYNC, Monitoring PPPoE, GenieACS device list and actions.
checks.name: test_tscheck_pppoe_monitoring.py
checks.evidence: GET /mikrotik/pppoe -> 200 list of session objects with router_name/username/status.

checks.criterion: Tickets and PSB create flow, plus Peta Jaringan fault analysis.
checks.name: tickets-psb-map-flow
checks.evidence: Created ticket (TKT-GMP-000007) via dialog -> toast 'TKT-GMP-000007 dibuat - WhatsApp ke Andi Teknisi terkirim', row visible in list. Created PSB (tscheck-psb-...) via dialog -> row visible. Peta Jaringan page renders Leaflet map with Rumah Pelanggan/ODP/ODC/Teknisi/PSB/Tiket legend counts and 'Dugaan Gangguan Kabel' side panel with 'Analisa Ulang' button, no blank render.

checks.name: test_tscheck_tickets_psb_technician.py
checks.evidence: POST /tickets -> 200 TKT-GMP-xxxx; POST /psb -> 200 PSB-GMP-xxxx; technician assignment endpoints verified.

checks.name: login-rbac-dashboard-preview
checks.evidence: Login via https://github-import-deploy-1.preview.emergentagent.com reached Dashboard with Total Pelanggan stat visible.

checks.criterion: Reports/Audit/Settings coverage (supporting backend artifact already present in repo).
